title: OpenAI and Amazon announce strategic partnership
summary: OpenAI and Amazon announce a strategic partnership bringing OpenAI’s Frontier platform to AWS, expanding AI infrastructure, custom models, and enterprise AI agents.
body: OpenAI and Amazon announce a strategic partnership bringing OpenAI’s Frontier platform to AWS, expanding AI infrastructure, custom models, and enterprise AI agents.
summaryZh: OpenAI与亚马逊宣布达成战略合作伙伴关系，将OpenAI的Frontier平台引入AWS云基础设施。此次合作旨在通过扩展AI基础设施、提供定制化模型服务，加速企业级AI Agent的开发与部署，进一步推动云端AI生态的深度融合。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI与亚马逊达成战略合作，将前沿模型引入AWS，加速企业级AI Agent落地。
aiReview.summaryZh: OpenAI与亚马逊宣布达成战略合作伙伴关系，将OpenAI的Frontier平台引入AWS云基础设施。此次合作旨在通过扩展AI基础设施、提供定制化模型服务，加速企业级AI Agent的开发与部署，进一步推动云端AI生态的深度融合。

glossary.explanationZh: 指OpenAI提供的尖端模型及相关开发平台。
指面向企业级应用场景的自动化智能体。
